hero_subtext: The official gathering place for Florida Gators alumni and fans across Raleigh, Durham and the surrounding areas. Watch parties every game day, service in the community, and a whole lot of orange and blue.
who_text: We're the Florida Gators club for Raleigh, Durham and the surrounding areas — a few hundred alumni, transplants and adopted Gators who show up loud on Saturdays and give back the rest of the week.
events_text: Watch parties, socials and service days across the Triangle. Everyone is welcome — degree or not.
den_text: Our day-to-day lives in a private Facebook group — last-minute watch party changes, ticket swaps, tailgate plans and the group chat energy you'd expect from Gator Nation. Request to join and a board member will approve you.
den_note: Private group · approval usually within 24 hours
